facts.note: Nine o'clock temple bell, watches shown; Ruedi's exact, doctor (Dr Vauthier) two minutes ahead, Girard would not take his out of his pocket.
Hall clock struck ten while the regulator showed 9:48; master's remark withheld; regulator agreed exactly with the temple bell at ten.
Sent downstairs when the regulator showed 10:20; regulator running and master well; went straight to the kitchen.
That afternoon, master seen in kitchen with Rosa's clock in his hands, laughing; she did not ask why.
Rosa's clock read 10:58 when the piano began and 11:11 when it stopped, in the kitchen.
Stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.
